answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 20615 Country: India Title: My question is today is miladunnabi on this day we make happiness and make a special dish at home is it right? Some people read kuran ayten in front of special dish is it islamic? Question: My question is today is miladunnabi on this day we make happiness and make a special dish at home is it right? Some people read kuran ayten in front of special dish is it islamic? Answer ID: 20615 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 422/351/B=1431) Celebrating Eid Meelad al-nabi, making merry and preparing special dish on his birthday, all these acts neither are proved by the Quran and Hadith nor is its example found in the earlier periods Islam certified as reliable. The companions loved the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) very much but they never celebrated Eid Meelad. This is the invention of the Christians, we must not follow them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
